name: Seko Katsuhiko
source: An ace in the long distance relay section of the track and field club, he joined Keisen Academy just so he could run in the long distance relay event alongside [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url], his close friend. His dislike of females generates rumors about him being in a relationship with [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url].
